title: What If Humans Never Invented Clothes?
tags: what if humans never invented clothes
description:
The sidewalk beneath your bare feet just turned blue — and in a world where nobody ever invented clothes, that means the city’s heat is dying. No jackets. No shoes. No pockets. Just enclosed glass streets, glowing floor strips and one freezing night in Chicago. Your friend Maya is trapped on a tram over a frozen river with 18 minutes of battery left… and the only way to save her is a forgotten pipe, a rusted valve and a bread truck. Would humanity even survive winter without a single coat? Watch till the end to find out 🥶🔥

title: What If You Relived One Fight Until You Beat Prime Mike Tyson?
description:
What if you were stuck reliving one fight until you beat prime Mike Tyson?

Every time he knocks you out, you wake up in the same motel, on the same day in 1988, in the same ordinary body. Your muscles reset. Only what you learn stays. You can't get stronger than Tyson. You can only get smarter.

19 straight knockouts to start a career, the youngest heavyweight champion ever, the 91-second fight, the peek-a-boo guard, and the 42-to-1 night in Tokyo that showed the one way in.

How many attempts would it take you? Drop your number below.

A work of fiction inspired by real boxing history. Not affiliated with Mike Tyson.

title: What IF Humans Never Invented CLOTHES?
tags: what if humans never invented clothes
description:
What IF humans never invented clothes? 👕🌿

Imagine a world with no hoodies, no jeans, no pockets and no fashion shows. How would people survive the cold? Would schools, offices and stores look completely different? And who would become the first person to invent a jacket? In this video, we find out what would happen if clothes never existed.

⏱️ In this video:
• How people would survive winter, rain and summer heat
• What would happen to school, work and everyday life
• The strange problems nobody thinks about (like where to keep your phone)
• Who would invent the first piece of clothing, and what it would look like

👍 If you enjoyed the video, like it and subscribe for a new "What IF" every week!

title: What If You Were Stuck in a Time Loop Until You Beat Ayrton Senna?
description:
You blink, and you're strapped into a McLaren on a soaking wet grid. Donington Park, 11 April 1993. Two cars ahead of you sits Ayrton Senna, about to drive the greatest opening lap in Formula One history. The loop only ends when you beat him to the line at the end of lap one, on the real track, with no shortcuts.

How long would it take? 80 years just to stop finishing last. Thousands more to catch Schumacher, Wendlinger, Hill and Prost. And then the one corner where even Senna isn't perfect.

0:00 Strapped into Senna's race
1:07 The rules of the loop
1:38 Who you're up against
1:59 Lap one is your only school
3:14 What rain does to a racing car
3:58 Year 400 to Year 3,500
4:38 The one gap Senna leaves
5:18 Year 6,000
5:57 Waking up

Who's the greatest driver of all time? Tell me in the comments.

Real race facts: European Grand Prix, Donington Park, 11 April 1993. Senna started 4th, dropped to 5th, and passed Schumacher, Wendlinger, Hill and Prost on lap one. He won by 1:23.199 and lapped everyone except Damon Hill. Michael Andretti retired on lap one after a collision with Karl Wendlinger. The winner's trophy was a Sonic the Hedgehog statue.

title: What If You Were Stuck in a Time Loop Until You Solved a Rubik's Cube in Under 10 Seconds?
tags: how to solve a rubik's cube
description:
You wake up to a scrambled Rubik's Cube and a note: solve it in under ten seconds, or today starts over. Loop by loop you go from random twisting (43 quintillion possible positions) to a beginner's method, then to CFOP and its 78 last-layer algorithms, past the winning time from the very first world championship in 1982, and into the famous superflip and the proof that every position can be solved in 20 moves or fewer. The Speedcuber is an original character; the math, history and records are real.

How many loops would it take you to break ten seconds? Tell me in the comments!

title: What If Humans Never Invented Doors?
tags: what if humans never invented doors
description:
Your neighbor is taking a shower in full view of the sidewalk, a stranger is on your couch eating your cereal, and nobody thinks any of it is strange. In this world, nobody ever invented the door.
 
No keys. No locks. No fridge. No bank vault, no elevators, no privacy... and one night you build a small, ugly thing out of a tabletop that gets you dragged in front of the whole town.
 
In this video: why a house with no door is "a very detailed tent," the real 9,000-year-old town where people entered their homes through the roof, the 5,000-year-old door found under a parking garage in Zurich, why the Romans gave doors their own god, and what a door is really for.
 
If you woke up as the only person on Earth who knew what a door was, which one would you build first: the bedroom, the bathroom, or the fridge? Tell me in the comments.
 
Subscribe so you don't miss the next world. It's even stranger.
